description_en: Creates a cloud-native Tair (Enterprise Edition) instance
description_zh: 创建云原生版的Tair（企业版）实例
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore create-tair-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-class tair.scm.standard.4m.32d --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --instance-type tair_scm --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTairInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list. Use this parameter to specify the region where you want to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must meet the following requirements:
The name must be 2 to 80 characters in length.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot contain spaces or the following special characters: `@/:=”<>{[]}`
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称，需满足下述要求：
长度为2~80个字符。
以大小写英文字母或中文开头，不支持空格和特殊字符：`@/:=”<>{[]}`
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance password. The password must meet the following requirements:
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and digits. Supported special characters are `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh:
实例密码，需满足下述要求：
长度为8~32位。
需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的至少三种，支持的特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. For more information, see:
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527112.html.
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527110.html.
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格，更多信息，请参见：
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527112.html。
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527110.html。
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The primary active zone ID. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent active zone list. Use this parameter to specify the active zone where you want to create the instance.
You can also specify the SecondaryZoneId parameter to set the secondary active zone. The primary and secondary nodes will be placed in the specified primary and secondary active zones to implement a dual-active-zone primary/secondary architecture deployment. For example, set the ZoneId parameter to "cn-hangzhou-h" and the SecondaryZoneId parameter to "cn-hangzhou-g"
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的可用区。
您也可以再传入SecondaryZoneId参数指定备可用区，主备节点将分别部署在指定的主可用区和备可用区，实现同城双中心主备架构。例如指定ZoneId参数为"cn-hangzhou-h"，指定SecondaryZoneId参数为"cn-hangzhou-g"
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent zone list.

The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter, and you cannot specify the ID of a multi-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询。

本参数和ZoneId参数传入的值不能相同，且不可传入多可用区对应的ID
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription. This is the default value.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
PrePaid（默认）：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html operation of the VPC API to query the VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID，可调用专有网络VPC的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html获取
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the VPC. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html operation of the VPC API to obtain the vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 该专有网络下的虚拟交换机ID，可调用专有网络VPC的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html获取
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, 36, and 60.
This parameter is required when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
付费周期，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36、60 。
当ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The activity ID and business information
parameters.help_zh: 活动ID、业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code
parameters.help_zh: 优惠码
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the source instance. If you want to create an instance based on the backup set of an existing instance, specify instance ID of the source instance in this parameter.
Then, specify the backup set or point in time by using the BackupId, ClusterBackupId (recommended for cloud-native cluster architectures), or RestoreTime parameter. This parameter must be used in combination with one of the preceding three parameters
parameters.help_zh:
如需基于某个实例的备份集创建新实例，请先在此参数中指定源实例ID。
然后通过BackupId、ClusterBackupId（云原生集群架构建议使用ClusterBackupId）或RestoreTime参数指定需要使用的备份集或指定时间点，本参数需要与上述3个中的任意一个参数组合使用
parameters.name: src_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set of the source instance. The system uses the data in the specified backup set to create the instance. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to query the backup set ID. If the source instance is a cluster instance, you must enter the backup set IDs of all shards in the source instance and separate them with commas, such as "10,11,15**".
If your instance is a cloud-native architecture instance, we recommend that you invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html operation to query the cluster backup set ID, such as "cb-xx", and then specify the ClusterBackupId request parameter to clone the cluster instance. This saves you the trouble of entering the backup set ID of each shard
parameters.help_zh:
您可在此参数中指定源实例的备份集ID，系统将使用该备份集中保存的数据创建新实例。通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html可查询BackupId。如果源实例是集群实例，则此处需要填写源实例各个分片的备份集id，并且通过逗号隔开，例如"10**,11**,15**"。
若您的实例是云原生架构实例，并且是集群实例，则建议您使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html查询出集群备份集id，例如"cb-xx"，然后填入ClusterBackupId请求参数来达到克隆集群实例的目的，免去您输入各个分片备份集id的烦恼
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster backup set. Some new cluster architectures support cluster backup set IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html operation to obtain the ID.
If the cluster architecture supports cluster backup sets, you can enter the specified cluster backup set ID. You do not need to specify the BackupId parameter.
If the cluster architecture does not support cluster backup sets, enter the backup set IDs of all shards in the source instance in the BackupId parameter and separate them with commas, such as "2158\\20,2158\\22"
parameters.help_zh:
部分新集群架构支持集群备份集ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html接口获取。
若支持，可输入指定的集群备份集ID即可，无需再填写BackupId参数。
若不支持，请在BackupId参数中填写为原实例各个分片下的备份集ID，通过逗号隔开，例如"2158\\20,2158\\22"等
parameters.name: cluster_backup_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restore the account, kernel parameters, and whitelist from the original backup set when you create an instance by using a specified backup set. For example, to restore the account information, set the value to account.

Default value: empty. An empty value indicates that the account, kernel parameters, and whitelist are not restored from the original backup set.
This parameter applies only to cloud-native instances and requires that the original backup set contains the account, kernel parameters, and whitelist information. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to query whether the RecoverConfigMode parameter of a specified backup set contains the preceding information
parameters.help_zh:
使用指定备份集创建实例时，是否从原备份集中恢复账号（account）、内核参数（config）、白名单（whitelist）信息。例如需恢复账号信息，则取值为account。

默认为空，表示不从原备份集中恢复账号、内核参数、白名单信息。
本参数仅适用于云原生版实例，且需要原备份集中已保存了账号、内核参数、白名单信息。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html接口查询指定备份集中的RecoverConfigMode参数是否包含上述信息
parameters.name: recover_config_mode

parameters.help_en:
The internal IP address of the instance.

The IP address must fall within the CIDR block of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35748.html operation of the VPC API to query the CIDR block information
parameters.help_zh:
指定实例的内网IP地址。

该地址需在实例所属交换机的网段内，您可以调用专有网络VPC的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35748.html获取网段信息
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a voucher. Valid values:
true: uses a voucher.
false: does not use a voucher. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券，取值：
true：使用代金券。
false（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.
This parameter is required when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。
当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination resource group.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation or use the console to obtain the resource group ID list. For related operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html.
Before you change the resource group to which the instance belongs, you can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158866.html operation to view the current resource group of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
目标资源组ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口或通过控制台获取资源组ID列表。相关操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html。
修改实例所属的资源组之前，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158866.html接口查看实例现在所属的资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Set the value to true
parameters.help_zh: 自动支付，取值固定为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values: essd_pl1, essd_pl2, and essd_pl3.
This parameter is required only when the InstanceType parameter is set to tair_essd and you create an ESSD-based instance
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值为essd_pl1、essd_pl2、essd_pl3。
当InstanceType取值为tair_essd时，且创建ESSD型时，才需要输入本参数
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the disk-based instance. The valid values vary based on the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html.
This parameter is required only when the InstanceType parameter is set to tair_essd and you create an ESSD-based instance. If you create a Tair disk-based SSD instance, the capacity field is defined as a fixed value based on the instance type, and you do not need to specify this field
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘型实例的存储空间，不同的规格取值范围有所区别，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html。
当InstanceType取值为tair_essd时，且创建ESSD型时，才需要输入本参数。对于创建 Tair 磁盘SSD型实例，容量字段按不同的规格定义为不同的固定值，无需指定该字段
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:
MASTER_SLAVE: High-availability Edition. This edition uses a primary/secondary architecture to ensure high availability. This is the default value.
STAND_ALONE: Standalone Edition. This edition uses a single-node architecture. If a node fails, data is lost and the system automatically creates a new empty instance. This edition is supported only in single-zone deployments and does not support cluster or read/write splitting architectures
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
MASTER_SLAVE（默认）：高可用，采用主备架构，可保障可用性。
STAND_ALONE：单副本，采用单节点架构。在节点故障后，数据会丢失，系统会自动拉起新的空实例。仅在单可用区时支持，且不支持创建集群与读写分离架构
parameters.name: shard_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of data nodes in the instance. Valid values:
1: creates a https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html that has only one data node. This is the default value.
2 to 32: creates a https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html that has the specified number of data nodes.

You can set this parameter to a value from 2 to 32 only when the InstanceType parameter is set to tair_rdb or tair_scm. This means that only memory-enhanced and persistent memory-optimized instances support the cluster architecture
parameters.help_zh:
实例中的数据节点个数，取值：
1：默认值，即表示创建的实例为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html，仅拥有1个数据节点。
2~32：传入该范围的值，即表示创建的实例为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html，拥有指定数量的数据节点。

当InstanceType取值为tair_rdb或tair_scm时，本参数才可以传入2~32，即只有内存型和持久内存型支持集群架构
parameters.name: shard_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of secondary nodes in the primary zone. This parameter applies only when you create a cloud-native cluster instance with multiple replicas. You can use this parameter to specify the number of secondary nodes. Valid values: 1 to 4.
If you create a multi-zone instance, you can use this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter to specify the number of secondary nodes in the primary and secondary zones. The sum of the values of this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter cannot exceed 4
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的备节点数，本参数仅适用于创建云原生版集群多副本实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义备节点数量，取值：1~4。
若创建多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数自定义主、备可用区的备节点数量。同时，该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数的总和不能超过4
parameters.name: replica_count

parameters.help_en: The number of secondary nodes in the secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的备节点数量
parameters.name: slave_replica_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the primary zone. This parameter applies only when you create a cloud-native read/write splitting instance.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, valid values are 1 to 9.
If the instance uses the cluster architecture, valid values are 1 to 4, which indicate the number of read-only nodes per data shard.
If you create a multi-zone instance, you can use this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter to specify the number of read-only nodes in the primary and secondary zones.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, the sum of the values of this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter cannot exceed 9.
If the instance uses the cluster architecture, the sum of the values of this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter cannot exceed 4
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数，本参数仅适用于创建云原生读写分离实例。
若实例为标准架构，取值为1~9。
若实例为集群架构，取值为1-4，表示每数据分片的只读节点数。
若创建多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数和SlaveReadOnlyCount参数自定义主备可用区的只读节点数量。
若实例为标准架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于9。
若实例为集群架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于4
parameters.name: read_only_count

parameters.help_en: The number of read-only nodes in the secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数量
parameters.name: slave_read_only_count

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version. Default value: 1.0. The value varies based on the Tair instance type:
Tair_rdb: Tair memory-enhanced instances are compatible with Redis 5.0, Redis 6.0, and Redis 7.0 protocols. Set the value to 5.0, 6.0, or 7.0.
Tair_scm: Tair persistent memory-optimized instances are compatible with the Redis 6.0 protocol. Set the value to 1.0.
Tair_essd: Tair disk-based (ESSD/SSD) instances are compatible with the Redis 6.0 protocol. Set the value to 1.0 for ESSD-based instances and 2.0 for SSD-based instances
parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本，默认取值：1.0，不同 Tair 产品类型传参规则：
Tair_rdb: Tair 内存型兼容Redis 5.0、Redis 6.0和Redis 7.0协议，传5.0、6.0或7.0。
Tair_scm: Tair 持久内存兼容Redis 6.0协议，传1.0。
Tair_essd: Tair 磁盘（ESSD/SSD）兼容Redis 6.0协议。 创建ESSD型请传入1.0、创建SSD型请传入2.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The storage medium. Valid values:
tair_rdb: memory-enhanced.
tair_scm: persistent memory-optimized.
tair_essd: disk-based
parameters.help_zh:
存储介质，取值：
tair_rdb：内存型。
tair_scm：持久内存型。
tair_essd：磁盘型
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the new instance as a child instance in a distributed instance. You can use this parameter to create a distributed instance.
To use the new instance as the first child instance, set the value to true.
To use the new instance as the second or third child instance, set the value to the ID of the distributed instance, such as gr-bp14rkqrhac****.
If you do not want to use the new instance as a child instance in a distributed instance, leave this parameter empty.
The new instance must be a Tair memory-enhanced instance if you want to use it as a child instance in a distributed instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否将本次新建的实例作为分布式实例中的子实例，通过该方式可创建分布实例。
若希望新建的实例作为第一个子实例，请输入true。
若希望新建的实例作为第二、三个子实例，请输入分布式实例 ID，例如gr-bp14rkqrhac****。
不作为分布式实例，您无需输入任何值。
若希望作为分布式实例，本次新建的实例需为Tair内存型
parameters.name: global_instance_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. A tag key and a tag value form a key-value pair.
You can specify up to 5 tag key-value pairs at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签的键，与Tag Value组成标签的键值对。
单次最多支持传入5组标签的键值对
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.
N indicates the sequence number of the tag. For example, Tag.1.Value indicates the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value indicates the value of the second tag
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag information of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run before you create the instance. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without creating the instance. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources. If the request fails the dry run, the system returns an error. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns the `DryRunOperation` error code.
false: sends the request. If the request passes the check, the instance is created. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建实例的操作执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The service port of the instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Default value: 6379
parameters.help_zh: 实例的服务端口，取值范围：1~65535，默认值为6379
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The global IP address whitelist templates of the instance. Separate multiple whitelist templates with commas (,). Each template must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 实例的全局IP白名单模板，多个IP白名单模板请用英文逗号（,）分隔，不可重复
parameters.name: global_security_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parameter template. The instance is created based on the parameters in the specified template. Each template ID must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 参数模板ID，根据新创建的参数模板参数创建实例，不可重复
parameters.name: param_group_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the source instance. If the data flashback feature is enabled for the source instance, you can specify a point in time within the backup retention period of the source instance. The system uses the backup data of the source instance at the specified point in time to create the instance. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 若源实例已开启数据闪回，您可在此参数中指定源实例备份保留周期内的任意时间点，系统将使用源实例在该时间点的备份数据创建新实例。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the endpoint. The prefix must be 8 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters and digits. It must start with a lowercase letter.


The endpoint is in the following format: <Prefix-Instance ID>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址的前缀，需由小写英文字母与数字组成，以小写字母开头，长度为8~40个字符。


连接地址格式为：<前缀-实例ID>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint type used when you create a cloud-native Dual-active-zone deployment read/write splitting instance. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is AzIndependentEndpoint.

AzIndependentEndpoint: active zone-independent endpoint. This is the default value. Independent endpoints are provided for the primary and secondary active zones. You can use different endpoints to achieve nearest access.
UnifiedEndpoint: unified endpoint. A unified endpoint is provided to access nodes in both the primary and secondary active zones. However, cross-active-zone access may occur.

<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud-native Dual-active-zone deployment read/write splitting instances. For other types of instances, only active zone-independent endpoints are supported. Even if you specify UnifiedEndpoint, it does not take effect.></notice>

<notice>The UnifiedEndpoint parameter is currently available only to whitelisted users. If you are not a whitelisted user and specify this parameter, an invoke error is returned. To request access, commit a ticket.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
创建云原生双可用区读写分离实例时，使用的连接地址类型。不显式传该参数时，值默认为AzIndependentEndpoint。

AzIndependentEndpoint : 默认值。可用区独立连接地址。主、备可用区分别提供独立连接地址，可通过不同的连接地址实现可用区就近访问。
UnifiedEndpoint : 统一连接地址。提供统一的连接地址，通过该地址同时访问到主备可用区的节点，但会出现跨可用区访问。

<notice>该参数仅适用于云原生双可用区读写分离实例。对于其他类型实例，仅支持可用区独立连接地址，即使传入UnifiedEndpoint也不会真正生效。></notice>

<notice> UnifiedEndpoint 参数目前仅面向白名单用户开放。非白名单用户传入该参数将导致调用报错。如需开通使用权限，请提交工单申请加白。></notice>
parameters.name: instance_endpoint_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the maintenance window. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. For example, if you want the maintenance window to start at 01:00 (UTC+8), set the value to `17:00Z`. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 18:00 (UTC), which is 02:00 (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 设置实例可维护时段的开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。例如，需要在北京时间凌晨1点开始，应设置为`17:00Z`。 若不设置，值默认为UTC时间18:00，即北京时间凌晨2:00
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the maintenance window. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. For example, if you want the maintenance window to end at 02:00 (UTC+8), set the value to `18:00Z`. The interval between the start time and the end time must be at least 1 hour. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 22:00 (UTC), which is 06:00 (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 设置实例可维护时段的结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。例如，需要在北京时间凌晨2点结束，应设置为`18:00Z`。 开始时间和结束时间的间隔不能低于1小时。 若不设置，值默认为UTC时间22:00，即北京时间凌晨6:00
parameters.name: maintain_end_time
